ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE

Behind the image
09 / Ochre Study
REFERENCE 4993.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 011
Art direction: Neutral studio lighting and no distracting props. Keep the dress silhouette legible.
Full length studio fashion editorial of an original adult woman with long copper-red wavy hair
wearing a fitted ochre mustard mini dress, long sleeves, Mandarin inspired high collar, small oval
neckline cutout, crossed twist detail at the bodice, gently ruched sides. Minimal silver rings and
small blush handbag, pure white seamless background, soft even studio lighting, 1970s inspired
modern fashion styling, clear garment detail, no lettering.
10 / Cocoa Knit
REFERENCE 5028.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 012
Art direction: Late-1990s / early-2000s knitwear, chocolate and burgundy palette, controlled white
backdrop.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
straight chestnut-brown hair, a blunt fringe and a few strands lifted by the wind, a calm direct gaze
and natural makeup. She wears a fitted chocolate-brown turtleneck with a ruched center seam, a
jeweled statement necklace and a plum-and-brown striped skirt with blue trim. Clean white
seamless studio background, soft even light, late-1990s knitwear mood, chocolate and burgundy
palette, crisp fabric texture, no text or logos.
